fact: eGA says it developed Uganda's Government Enterprise Architecture and e-Government Interoperability Framework with NITA-U about five years before this February 2026 article, which reports NITA-U launching their renewal with World Bank support.

eGA reports that the Government of Uganda renewed its Government Enterprise Architecture, led by NITA-U with World Bank support, delivering a renewed architecture aligned with Vision 2040; the article is dated 2026-05-27 and gives no earlier completion date.

The NITA-U 2022 National IT Survey reports that staff of government MDAs use the internet for backend operations such as accessing IFMIS (75.8% in one table and 70.1% in another), and that 88.4% of MDAs want to use centralised platforms such as IFMIS; the document gives no date for the system's use, so the publication date is used.

Uganda's REAP strategy page refers to a current pension and payroll system, whose functional and technical challenges are to be addressed by replacing the underlying application with a Human Capital Management system.
